{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = "/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv"
data = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Step 1: Identify QA orders (revenue == '999999.99')
qa_mask = data['revenue'] == '999999.99'
qa_orders = data[qa_mask]

# Step 2: Exclude QA orders and refunded orders
completed_data = data[~qa_mask & (data['status'] == 'completed')]

# Step 3: Parse revenue as float (remove commas)
completed_data['revenue_float'] = completed_data['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Step 4: Compute conversion rate by channel and customer_segment
channel_segment_conv = completed_data.groupby(['channel', 'customer_segment'])['converted'].mean().reset_index(name='conversion_rate')

# Step 5: Compute total number of orders per customer_segment
segment_counts = completed_data.groupby('customer_segment').size().reset_index(name='n')

# Step 6: Compute weighted conversion rate per channel
channel_segment_conv = channel_segment_conv.merge(segment_counts, on='customer_segment')
channel_segment_conv['weighted_rate'] = channel_segment_conv['conversion_rate'] * channel_segment_conv['n']

total_weighted = channel_segment_conv.groupby('channel')['weighted_rate'].sum() / channel_segment_conv['n'].sum()
total_weighted = total_weighted.reset_index(name='weighted_conversion_rate')

# Step 7: Compute difference (email - paid_search)
difference = total_weighted[total_weighted['channel'] == 'email']['weighted_conversion_rate'].values[0] - \
              total_weighted[total_weighted['channel'] == 'paid_search']['weighted_conversion_rate'].values[0]

# Print all required numbers explicitly
print(f"Number of QA orders: {qa_orders.shape[0]}")
print(f"Number of customer_age == -1 in completed data: {completed_data[completed_data['customer_age'] == -1].shape[0]}")

print("\nConversion rate by channel and segment:")
print(channel_segment_conv[['channel', 'customer_segment', 'conversion_rate']])

print("\nTotal orders per segment:")
print(segment_counts)

print("\nWeighted conversion rates per channel:")
print(total_weighted)

print(f"\nDifference (email - paid_search): {difference}")"}
